qualityGates: Every asset slot receives a stable logical ID before final art replacement.
Map composition uses the 48px engine grid where applicable.
Child NPC assets remain age appropriate.
Guardian silhouettes remain readable and distinct from hostile monsters.
Crownweave wealth must show social and occupational variety rather than making every resident aristocratic.
Central-bank and civic spaces must remain visually navigable on a phone screen.
Story-state variants must preserve collision and interaction semantics when visuals change.
All final art will be original Plushbound work rather than copied proprietary RPG Maker assets.
The 2x reserve is fulfilled through meaningful modular alternatives, not blind recolors.
Placeholder assets must never be represented as completed final artwork.
completionDefinition: This package completes Crownweave's regional placeholder/specification target for the finished-game-first workflow. Binary final artwork is intentionally deferred until the complete playable project ZIP exists and can undergo a unified MV-cover/Trinity-inspired Plushbound visual replacement pass.
